packageRules.description: Everything is off by default. PR #94 was closed over weekly PR noise, so routine version bumps do not raise PRs; the dashboard still lists them.
Security advisories always raise a PR, whatever the ecosystem.

Action digest pins: grouped into one PR, but NEVER automerged. This repo has no branch protection, so an automerged digest bump is a compromised upstream tag landing on main with no human in the loop -- which turns the SHA pins back into tag-following. A human reviews the PR; the dashboard surfaces it.
